senses.gloss: m.(v. ֵבֶל ch. 2) loom, also the web on the loom.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 38:12">Targ. Is. XXXVIII, 12</cite> <he>מנוול גרדאין</he> Var. ed. Lag. (read: <he>כְּמִנְּוַול</he>; ed. <he>נחל</he>, corr. acc.; oth. ed. <he>כִּנְוַל</he>) as from the loom (as the web) of the weavers.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Batra 2:3:6">Y. B. Bath. II, 13ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>מיתן חד נוול וכ׳</he> to place one loom in the space between two neighboring walls. Bab.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 13b:7">B. Bath. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>ידעא פילכא ונ׳</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 8) understands the spindle and the loom (spinning and weaving).—Pl. <he>נַוְולַיָּה</he>. Y. l. c. (ed. Krot. <he>דנו ליה</he>, corr. acc.), v. <cite ref="M01970"><he>מַסְמְרָא</he></cite>.
